spec_match.rationale: Performs support probing by setting attribute markup on a probe element and reading back to check if < > escaping is supported.

interactive.rationale: Highly interactive environment enabling users to write custom strings, select input methods, select attack presets, and see full step-by-step XSS parsing outputs.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Very thorough and interactive playground clarifying the exact exploitation mechanics and the fix.

edge_cases.rationale: The playground works perfectly on any browser by illustrating both vulnerable and protected behaviors clearly.

design_system.rationale: Strictly follows design system variables with high-contrast text highlight colors.
